red_check.note: one token per sign, right to left; '?' = not read; 'ر/ز' = a red curl that can be ر ز د or و; 'ـ' = a flat red stroke (dotless ب/ت/ن or a bowl). About 40 of 79 red marks give a shape; few are certain letters.

verdict: no plaintext: inventory only; sign count by eye with several faint signs; red gloss mostly unreadable
notes: f. 1r, image 0084_0006. In this run's segmentation the six cipher rows are segmenter lines 2-7 (the record's note, from an earlier segmentation, lists 2,3,5,6,7,8); segmenter line 8 is the start of the naskh note 'ثم الالف واحدا ...', not cipher. By eye 15+14+14+12+13+11 = 79 signs (record estimate 85 +-8) and 18 dividers (three dots over a stem; record: not counted), 19 groups (groups run over row ends unless a divider closes the row; only row 5 ends with one). Faint and uncertain: row 2 sign 6 (a faint ع-like, counted as S3), row 4 left part (one divider with a single visible dot; X1, X2 illegible), row 6 left end (X3), S20 (faint loops, shape uncertain); in rows 2 and 7 a bowl (S6) stands under a three-dot divider whose stem runs into the bowl's right arm: read as divider + bowl, but it could be one ث-like sign (then 2 dividers fewer). Shapes: 47 labels plus 3 illegible; many are Arabic-letter-like (ع, ح, ه, و, ط, ں, ک, ب, ف) or numeral-like (٢, ٩, ٥, 8, ٨-like), so the inventory is open-ended and probably over-split for faint copies. Red gloss: a red mark stands over most signs, but the red is pale and small; at 3x most marks are curls (ر/ز/د/و), flat strokes or single alif strokes. The readable ones run e.g. row 2 'ا ? ر ر | ا ر ? ر ر', row 3 '? ن د د | د د', which do not form Arabic words; no word could be read from the red letters. The record's 'ض over a sign in row 2 (right end)' was not confirmed: the red over the first sign of row 2 is a flat stroke (possibly a bowl). Lengths of the divider groups: 4,4,12,2,4,4,3,2,4,8,3,5,2,3,7,3,3,4,2; the 12-sign group (row 2 signs 9-15 + row 3 signs 1-5) is long for one word, so a divider at the left end of row 2 may be lost in the stain, or some faint marks there are not signs.
